aloevera.name: Aloe Vera
aloevera.description: A succulent plant with thick, fleshy, gel-filled leaves.

medicinal_uses.title: Skin Care
medicinal_uses.text: Gel is traditionally applied on burns, minor wounds and dry skin.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Used in Ayurveda to support digestion and relieve constipation.

medicinal_uses.title: Hair Care
medicinal_uses.text: Gel is used traditionally to soothe the scalp and condition hair.

medicinal_uses.title: Immunity
medicinal_uses.text: Contains vitamins and antioxidants that support general wellness.

arali.name: Arali (Peepal)
arali.description: A large sacred fig tree with heart-shaped leaves and a long drip tip.

medicinal_uses.title: Respiratory Health
medicinal_uses.text: Bark and leaves are traditionally used for cough and asthma relief.

medicinal_uses.title: Skin Disorders
medicinal_uses.text: Leaf paste is used in folk medicine for wounds and skin problems.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Traditionally used to ease constipation and stomach complaints.

curryleaf.name: Curry Leaf
curryleaf.description: An aromatic leafy shrub widely used in South Indian cooking.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Helps relieve indigestion, nausea and stomach upset.

medicinal_uses.title: Hair Health
medicinal_uses.text: Traditionally used to support hair growth and reduce premature greying.

medicinal_uses.title: Blood Sugar
medicinal_uses.text: Folk medicine uses leaves to support healthy blood sugar levels.

medicinal_uses.title: Rich in Nutrients
medicinal_uses.text: Source of iron, calcium and antioxidants.

mint.name: Mint
mint.description: A fragrant herb with serrated leaves and a cooling taste.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Eases indigestion, gas and bloating.

medicinal_uses.title: Cold & Cough
medicinal_uses.text: Mint tea and steam are used to relieve congestion.

medicinal_uses.title: Oral Health
medicinal_uses.text: Freshens breath and is used in oral care.

medicinal_uses.title: Headache Relief
medicinal_uses.text: Mint oil is traditionally applied to relieve tension headaches.

neemleaf.name: Neem
neemleaf.description: A fast-growing evergreen tree known as the 'village pharmacy' of India.

medicinal_uses.title: Skin Health
medicinal_uses.text: Antibacterial properties; used for acne, eczema and skin infections.

medicinal_uses.title: Dental Care
medicinal_uses.text: Neem twigs have been used as natural toothbrushes.

medicinal_uses.title: Blood Purifier
medicinal_uses.text: Ayurveda uses neem to support detoxification.

medicinal_uses.title: Natural Pesticide
medicinal_uses.text: Neem extracts are used in organic farming.

pumpkin.name: Pumpkin
pumpkin.description: A trailing vine with large lobed leaves that produces edible orange fruit.

medicinal_uses.title: Eye Health
medicinal_uses.text: Rich in vitamin A. Improves vision.

medicinal_uses.title: Heart Health
medicinal_uses.text: Reduces cholesterol. Supports heart function.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: High fiber improves digestion. Prevents constipation.

medicinal_uses.title: Immunity Boost
medicinal_uses.text: Strengthens immune system. Rich in nutrients.

rose.name: Rose
rose.description: A flowering shrub with compound serrated leaves and fragrant flowers.

medicinal_uses.title: Skin Care
medicinal_uses.text: Rose water is used as a natural toner and skin soother.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Petal preparations like gulkand are used as a digestive coolant.

medicinal_uses.title: Stress Relief
medicinal_uses.text: Rose aroma is traditionally used to calm the mind.

tamarind.name: Tamarind
tamarind.description: A large tree with small, feather-like compound leaves and tangy pods.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Pulp is used as a mild natural laxative and digestive aid.

medicinal_uses.title: Antioxidant
medicinal_uses.text: Rich in polyphenols and vitamin C.

medicinal_uses.title: Sore Throat
medicinal_uses.text: Leaf and pulp decoctions are used in folk remedies.

jasmine.name: Jasmine
jasmine.description: A fragrant flowering shrub with glossy oval leaves, widely grown in India.

medicinal_uses.title: Stress Relief
medicinal_uses.text: Jasmine aroma is traditionally used to calm the mind and ease anxiety.

medicinal_uses.title: Skin Care
medicinal_uses.text: Jasmine oil is used in traditional skin care and as a moisturiser.

medicinal_uses.title: Headache Relief
medicinal_uses.text: Flower preparations are used in folk medicine for headaches.

pappaya.name: Papaya
pappaya.description: A fast-growing tropical tree with large, deeply lobed leaves and sweet fruit.

medicinal_uses.title: Digestion
medicinal_uses.text: Contains papain, an enzyme that helps digest protein.

medicinal_uses.title: Immunity
medicinal_uses.text: Fruit is rich in vitamin C and antioxidants.

medicinal_uses.title: Folk Use
medicinal_uses.text: Leaf juice is used traditionally in some regions during fever. Consult a doctor before using.

tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.description: A herbaceous plant with compound, toothed leaves that bears edible red fruit.

medicinal_uses.text: Rich in lycopene, an antioxidant linked to heart health.

medicinal_uses.title: Skin Health
medicinal_uses.text: Vitamin C and lycopene support healthy skin.

medicinal_uses.title: Eye Health
medicinal_uses.text: Contains vitamin A and lutein that support vision.

tulasi.name: Tulasi (Holy Basil)
tulasi.description: A sacred aromatic herb widely grown in Indian homes.

medicinal_uses.title: Cold & Cough
medicinal_uses.text: Tulasi tea and kadha are used traditionally for cough and cold.

medicinal_uses.title: Immunity
medicinal_uses.text: Ayurveda uses tulasi to support immunity.

medicinal_uses.title: Stress Relief
medicinal_uses.text: Considered an adaptogen that helps the body handle stress.

medicinal_uses.title: Respiratory Health
medicinal_uses.text: Used in traditional remedies for sore throat and congestion.
